_comment: Deterministic settings the plugin safety harness renders pomodoro-timer with for golden-image comparison. The timer is idle on a fresh instance, so the golden shows the resting screen: the idle label above the configured work length in seven-segment digits, a full burndown ring, and an empty set of session dots. Everything that affects the frame is pinned here so a future change to a schema default can't silently invalidate the goldens.
